name: ODE — Open Dining Experiences
description: A social dining platform for South Africa where diners pre-book curated set menus, join open tables with strangers, and unlock exclusive alcohol brand promotions.
features: Set course menu booking with seat tracking
Open tables — host or join a shared dining experience
Alcohol brand promotions redeemable at booking
Treat the Table — diners pre-purchase drinks for the whole table
TableTalk — interest-matched conversation starters for each event
Three-role auth: Diners, Restaurants, Brand Reps
Diner interest profiles with up to 12 selectable interests
